options.name: Anime Film Sinematik
options.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original anime cast visual-development reference, for an Indonesian emotional drama called Senja di Jembatan. Create ONE premium landscape illustration with EXACTLY FOUR different characters together in a clean full-body cast lineup, left to right Arga, Kirana, Pak Hendra, Sena. Show each entire body including shoes, natural relaxed characteristic poses, aligned ground plane, generous space separating silhouettes. Professional hand-drawn Japanese 2D anime production art; believable anatomy and clothing construction, sophisticated face drawings, expressive eyes and nuanced hair clumps. The adults must look their specified ages and the teenage boy must look like a teenage boy. Avoid same-face syndrome. Improve anatomy over long skinny puppet rigs: natural neck lengths, convincing shoulders, elbows, hands and knees; approximately 7-head adults and slightly shorter teenage proportions.
Arga: Indonesian man age 27, tallest, lean but anatomically grounded broad shoulders, angular jaw, restrained melancholy, blue-gray eyes, layered tousled near-black navy hair with natural uneven fringe; dark navy tailored coat with a light warm-gray inner shirt, charcoal trousers, brown-black dress boots. Young architect who carries regret.
Kirana: Indonesian woman age 25, medium height, slender healthy adult build, soft oval face, almond warm reddish-brown eyes, tiny beauty mark below her left eye, long dark chestnut flowing hair with delicate fringe; terracotta cardigan over cream high-neck blouse, dark muted plum pleated midi skirt, warm tan belt, brown ankle boots. Thoughtful illustrator preparing to leave home.
Pak Hendra: Indonesian man age 54, nearly as tall as Arga, broadest shoulders with a mature solid build and slight stoop; noticeably mature face, strong jaw, fine forehead/eye/cheek wrinkles, narrow dark gray-brown eyes, short swept salt-and-pepper silver hair; slate blue blazer, off-white collared shirt, dark charcoal trousers, black oxford shoes. Kirana's father and a former senior train driver, quietly protective.
Sena: Indonesian teenage boy age 16, clearly shorter and younger than the others, youthful face, bright expressive green eyes, short dark indigo-black tousled bob with a small cowlick; muted teal hoodie with subtle mustard trim over cream tee, tapered dark navy trousers, blue-gray sneakers with pale soles. Kirana's younger brother, gently optimistic.
All four share a coherent production design but distinct facial structure and age. Warm natural light-to-medium tan complexions. Clothes modest and everyday. Do not add any extra people, inset portraits, duplicated faces, props blocking bodies, panel borders or watermarks. No photorealism, no 3D, no chibi, no flat geometric vector puppets, no extreme elongated limbs. Restrained typography: the four names spelled exactly "ARGA", "KIRANA", "PAK HENDRA", "SENA" subtly aligned beneath their respective figures.
Direction A: CINEMATIC ANIME FEATURE FILM. Delicate variable-width graphite-dark ink lines, luminous layered irises with restrained highlights, complex organic hair silhouettes, detailed but tasteful fabric folds, refined 2-to-3-tone cel shading with soft painted edge transitions. Gentle late-afternoon amber key light and cool lavender fill, subtle golden rim lighting. Rich muted warm palette. Pale warm ivory studio background with only an extremely faint watercolor suggestion of a sunset bridge, keep bodies unobscured. Emotionally intimate and elegant, high-budget theatrical anime character-design presentation. Small top-left heading: "A · CINEMATIC DRAMA".
